origem.texto1: Pikivoley emerged in the late 1990s in the Ciudad del Este region, as a street game played in neighborhoods.
origem.texto2: Today it is recognized as an official sport by the Paraguayan Government and is one of the most played sports in the country, second only to football.
origem.foto.alt: Pikivoley match on a grass court surrounded by trees, with the crowd around the net
origem.bandeira.alt: Paraguayan flag waving, in red, white and blue
